observations.title: Pause must stop future retries as well as visible work
observations.observation: During pause wrap-up, a quota-limited session still had a scheduled retry despite the expectation that workers had stopped. Its exact owned session was preserved and aborted; other sessions were not restarted.
observations.design_implication: Pause is durable operator intent, distinct from an idle or retry-wait observation.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Pause persists across quota reset and controller restart; no new dispatch occurs and unacknowledged cancellation remains visible.

observations.title: Accepted main and useful restart source diverged
observations.observation: Accepted main ended at whole001..007; the historical canonical checkout and the later partial pause checkpoint were different commits and roots.
observations.design_implication: A dashboard must display accepted baseline, current candidate and active worktree explicitly.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: An operator finds the intended restart tree without choosing the stale checkout; every test and review names its source.

observations.title: Green counts and zero-finding prose hid unfinished or defective work
observations.observation: The report records false zero-blocking claims, missing committed reports and real defects found after green component tests. Whole acceptance needed separate evidence.
observations.design_implication: Acceptance must be a configurable evidence gate, not a model message parser.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Fixtures with PASS text but failing exit or absent report never become accepted.

observations.title: Wrong imports and faulty probes created false findings or confidence
observations.observation: Several reviews initially used the wrong source root, treated an executable wrapper as a venv, or had a defective public probe. Corrected oracles changed the finding classification.
observations.design_implication: Review jobs need frozen source, explicit import roots, exit capture and harness/source error categories.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A wrong-import fixture is detected and a corrected probe preserves the original result without declaring a product regression.

observations.title: Provenance and original reports were easy to lose during integration
observations.observation: Integration previously dropped a unique provenance row sharing a branch label and attempted report-tip-only imports. Pause wrap-up preserved full histories,89 incoming rows and151 original report blobs.
observations.design_implication: Track contributor records by full identity/content and validate complete incoming histories.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Rows sharing a branch label survive union; original reports remain hash-identical after corrections.

observations.title: CI consumption and postmerge gates required manual reconstruction
observations.observation: Actual CI included an unexpected generic-Python run and a packaging ENOSPC failure followed by a required postmerge retry. Counters had to follow real executions across phases.
observations.design_implication: Use a carried invocation ledger tied to tested trees; reconcile bypassed tickets without rerunning green work.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Un-ticketed actual runs consume the appropriate project budget and component checks never masquerade as whole/postmerge qualification.

observations.title: Disk exhaustion interrupted work; growth required a recovery procedure
observations.observation: The dedicated guest grew from16 to64GiB, preserving rollback data and checking guest capacity. Earlier low space affected CI and forced selective cache retirement.
observations.design_implication: Expose guest/host capacity separately and provide a journalled stopped-only growth path.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A growth preview shows host reserve and guest outcome; interrupted stages recover without modifying base or unrelated VMs.

observations.title: Monitoring clients themselves consumed substantial RAM
observations.observation: A preserved receipt records multiple exact idle OpenCode attach viewers retired to recover memory; active workers and servers remained.
observations.design_implication: One collector should feed many lightweight panes; distinguish viewers from workers and engines.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Opening and closing comparison panes does not spawn unbounded native clients, abort workers or leak memory.

observations.title: Token totals needed message deduplication and semantic caveats
observations.observation: The13:20UTC audit counted272378305 recorded tokens including216160584 cached tokens across OpenCode/NVIDIA records. It excluded local models and unreported failures; session totals were not added again.
observations.design_implication: Show coverage and cache/output/reasoning inclusion explicitly; totals are not unique content or provider billing.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Replay of the same records through multiple endpoints yields identical totals; missing usage remains unknown.

observations.title: Provider429s occurred below configured local RPM target
observations.observation: Two audited windows had minimum local admission spacing about1.771351s and2.226696s and peaks16 and11 rollingRPM. These timestamps do not establish provider arrival or the429 cause.
observations.design_implication: Expose local admission, retry/cooldown and provider errors separately; do not infer account quota from local counts.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A429 at low observedRPM enters visible cooldown without claiming a rate-limit root cause or silently upgrading service.

observations.title: Advertised and effective context/runtime settings differed
observations.observation: The two-KAT trial recorded128k-advertised versus64k-native context mismatch. Strata requested residency but ran mapped when host commit headroom was insufficient.
observations.design_implication: Show requested/effective/observed context, quant, memory mode and concurrency before assigning work.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A configured limit never appears as tested capacity; mismatched model metadata blocks an incompatible launch.

observations.title: Automatic GPU placement violated the selected-device constraint
observations.observation: A historical lms load CLI attempt allocated8460MiB on the prohibited V100 and was unloaded before benchmark inference. Later SDK/UUID routes verified physical placement.
observations.design_implication: Store allowed physical UUIDs and verify actual allocation before inference; reject unsupported loader routes.
observations.confidence: documented incident; no new device test
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Swapped indices or disallowed allocation prevent first inference; no claimed qualification from configuration alone.

observations.title: Long generation could be unproductive while smaller tasks progressed
observations.observation: Strata recorded an8192-token256.185-second reasoning-only compaction without a useful summary. Other small slices delivered code after controller narrowing; failures included context, tool and reporting problems.
observations.design_implication: Display recent executable progress, compaction/context events and bounded task checkpoints; preserve useful WIP before reassignment.
observations.confidence: measured example and bounded case study
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A long-thinking fixture is labelled uncertain rather than completed; operator can narrow the task and retain original evidence.

observations.title: Native start output capture could remain tied to VM lifetime
observations.observation: The earlier audit reported a captured start pipe held open by QEMU; the field-test instructions retained a file-redirection workaround and protected the original start session.
observations.design_implication: Lifecycle operations need independently owned processes, bounded results and progress reporting.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A future standard-userWHPX test captures start JSON and returns at READY while VM stays running; dashboard exit cannot kill it.

observations.title: Default setup had host-specific prerequisites and readiness failures
observations.observation: The earlier audit reported standard-user ACL, WHPX reboot, SSH tool selection, CPU-feature and timeout problems. This host used owner patches and workarounds.
observations.design_implication: One-click claims require clean-machine qualification and honest prerequisite/capability reporting.
observations.confidence: historical reported audit; needs current triage
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A fresh supported standard-user host reaches verified readiness through public commands with recorded prerequisite and failure paths.

observations.title: Remote-only allocation drift left local capacity unused
observations.observation: Owner steering had to restore useful local work alongside remote actors. Later primary-local preference changed to Strata while older documents still referred to KAT defaults.
observations.design_implication: Availability/preferences need one dated policy and visible queue eligibility, not duplicated prose defaults.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Operator sees why a local pool is idle and the latest role/model preference wins without silently reloading active work.

observations.title: Growing handoffs became contradictory operational state
observations.observation: Pause wrap-up archived long chronological documents and reconciled a concise handoff, component manifest, source hashes and ordered restart queue.
observations.design_implication: Generate current summaries from structured task/evidence state while retaining immutable historical claims.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: One restart capsule reconstructs accepted/candidate/paused state and all links verify; historical instructions cannot auto-launch workers.

observations.title: Status-query errors may undercount ad-hoc admission occupancy
observations.observation: Planning inspection of the existing helper found a scoped URL-error branch returning an empty status map. Other checks exist; no actual over-admission incident was established.
observations.design_implication: An unknown source must not create capacity. Test the whole admission path under partial failures.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Partial status failures hold admissions until ownership/leases reconcile, including all registered endpoints.

observations.title: The mature lab VM is not automatically a clean distributable devbox
observations.observation: The field environment accumulated providers, model runtimes, worktrees, evidence and operator-specific scripts; recovery exports intentionally excluded credentials/whole databases.
observations.design_implication: Extract a reproducible clean recipe and a redacted demonstration exercise instead of shipping the current overlay.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: A clean build has pinned provenance and no account state; local/free demonstration and replay paths are distinguished.

observations.title: Provider transport and model quality failures were different phenomena
observations.observation: DeepSeek/Ultra attempts sometimes produced no tools or code after provider timeouts; other models produced source defects. Small parallel helper timings did not consistently predict real task delivery.
observations.design_implication: Record error category, controller help and comparable task outcomes; do not rank models by token speed alone.
observations.scope: One Windows field-test host and TRIO project; no live reproduction during dashboard planning.
observations.retest_criterion: Reports separate no-response transport failure, context/tool failure, code defect and accepted repair with denominators and confounds.
